factor_name: Five-day momentum reversal amplified by lagged volume shock

calculation.description: At decision date t, reverse the prior three-session price move ending at t-1 and amplify it by the logarithm of the prior-day volume surprise relative to its 20-session trailing mean. All inputs are lagged completed-day observations. Cross-sectional ranking is intended for portfolio use.

validation.regime_notes: The valid signal sample is concentrated in the recent volume-history segment and has only 103 daily cross-sectional observations; admission passes the benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates but uncertainty is high. Five-day and ten-day decay are positive, with strongest observed association at ten days.
